status: Exploratory extension: all historical periods have been available during earlier reviews; no independent untouched test claim.
features: Original Gaussian memory forecasts at coupling scales 0, 0.5, 1, minus drift; controls: trailing return means over 1,5,21,63 observations and log ratio of 20/252-session realized volatility.
targets: Direct origin-normalized price change at 1,5,21 sessions, residualized against expanding log-drift.
ridge_objective: Mean squared residual plus penalty times squared standardized coefficients; unpenalized intercept.
selector: Lowest matured prequential normalized MSE over previous 252 observations, at least 20 forecast origins; otherwise log-drift. Candidate controls: constant and drift. Separate selectors with and without memory.
intervals: 80 percent empirical absolute-error quantiles scaled by daily EWMA volatility (decay 0.94), learned only from matured past issued forecasts; no exchangeability guarantee.
evaluation: All years 2023-2026, identical origins; report per-year loss, ablation and baseline comparisons without selecting the best test year.
latest: Issue forecasts from latest available snapshot; record origin and input hashes, no invented exchange-calendar target dates.
